submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 4mm thickness is recommended because it is the only option that reliably satisfies the critical constraint of hands-on maintenance during shutdowns. As a "standard structural absorber," F2 is designed for low activation, unlike the dense alloy options (F1, F3) which typically contain high-Z materials that become highly radioactive in forward calorimeter environments. While F1 at 6mm would provide better energy resolution (3.215% vs 4.884%), it cannot be selected if it violates the hands-on maintenance requirement. F2 at 4mm provides acceptable energy resolution while ensuring operational access during shutdowns, which is essential for the experiment's maintenance schedule.
